name: Shared shopping list (one person takes the run)
use_when: a running shopping list for a house or apartment: groceries, a Costco, Target or Trader Joe's run
'grocery list', 'add it to the list', 'we're out of', 'who's going to the store', 'costco haul'
anyone adds items, some are urgent, and one person goes and checks things off
dont_use_when: each item needs its own person to bring it, a potluck or packing list (use claims)
splitting what the groceries cost (use split)
guarantees: one person holds the run at a time; while they do, only they check items off
no two open items share a name; at most 20 items
Done ends the run and removes only the checked items
a leaver's run opens up again and their items stay; a late joiner can add, flag or take the run

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Apt 4b groceries' or 'Target run'

urgent.description: true if the chat said asap, critical or we're out

items.description: Items from the chat, up to 20
